terms.gloss: a missile, a javelin or other weapon thrown
evidence: Liv. 34.39: missilibus Lacedaemoniī pugnābant (Lewis & Short s.v. missilis)
terms.comment: The adjective missilis used as a noun; Lewis & Short notes it is not in Cicero or Caesar.

terms.gloss: a weapon thrown or shot (javelin, arrow)

sources: Lewis & Short: missilis · Lewis & Short: telum
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 346.
